producer.source:
Encode ONLY latest speech as short tagged rows, one per scoped decision. Each row k=K|c=0 or 1 then optional |p=reference|a=amount|d=date|v=security answer|t=HH:MM|scope=current. End on a separate literal END line. No empty tags; no quotes, brackets, escaping, embedded pipes/equalities/newlines in values. No duplicate or unknown tags. Required k and c on EVERY row. k must be yes,confirm,answer,proposal,no,vague,too_much,paid,dispute,partial,third,wrong_number,deceased,callback,decline,human,plan,hardship,stop,unknown. c=0 for unfinished speech/correction, including trailing but/and/for; never invent completion. p is exact returned ID, human type credit card/personal loan/car loan, canonical credit_card/personal_loan/car_loan, exact displayed label, comma separated scoped targets, or all. Different amounts/dates/decisions REQUIRE separate rows. Never flatten amounts into comma lists. a decimal with at most two fractional digits, full, or total:decimal for a stated aggregate; d exact YYYY-MM-DD, day/month/year (day first), today, tomorrow, this weekday, next weekday, weekday, day month [year], or vague plain words. Preserve relative phrases: do not use host time or invent dates. v DOB normalized YYYY-MM-DD (numeric speech day then month then year), or four phone digits. Extract security answer into v even when kind=answer. Payment date goes into d, not v. No hidden facts. p omitted only for the currently asked single product or explicit collective answer all; yes in offer means acceptance of spoken offers, confirm in readback means later consent. Include actually asserted a/d even on yes/confirm so corrections cannot be mistaken for bare consent. Paid means current arrears already paid; historical closure/paid off is dispute; scoped negation is not positive paid. Honor plan/human/stop/hardship without incidental paid keywords overriding them. A named offered full amount can use a=full only when speech explicitly refers to it. Extract every sibling and incomplete component. A supplied date does not imply acceptance of an unstated amount. Examples (literal output strings):
k=yes|c=1
END

k=answer|c=1|v=1988-04-17
END

k=answer|c=1|v=1234
END

k=proposal|c=1|p=credit card|a=100.25|d=tomorrow
k=no|c=1|p=personal loan
k=paid|c=1|p=car loan
END

k=yes|c=1|p=all
END

k=yes|c=1|p=credit card
k=yes|c=1|p=personal loan
END

k=confirm|c=1|p=all
END

k=confirm|c=1|p=credit card
k=confirm|c=1|p=personal loan
END

k=partial|c=0|p=credit card|a=100
END
Scope is current only. Explicit stop, human, plan and hardship are independent priority events. In offer/readback a qualified yes is a correction, never bare yes. If any date or amount is negated, do not put it in positive d/a; output no if no positive proposal remains. Do not label hello or go ahead as yes. Distinguish accepting help first (yes) from insisting on a human (human).
Use the latest customer speech and recent spoken question/readback to identify the current phase. Always return event, raw_speech and admin; never omit a sibling clause or END.
